## Goal

One typed table gives every flavor its look: two or three colours, a particle preset and a projectile. An exported Chaos pick, keyed on the instance id, chooses another flavor's look. Behind `FX_FLAVOR_LIVE`, which ships **off**, a Ranged attacker stays in place and fires its flavor's projectile (arc, bolt, beam or swipe) at the Unit or hero it attacks; the hit lands as the entry ends. Cap the combined ladder/practice Jlore paid by games at 2,000 per account per UTC day, clamping the last grant while leaving XP, quests, and quest/track Jlore untouched and resetting at the next UTC day.
